title: Druqks Acid Mantis
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A grinding 808-fuelled acid workout in C minor where a square-wave bassline's filter opens from a low rumble to a howling 3kHz scream across successive sections. The rhythm escalates from a minimal kick-hat groove to a full battery of four-on-the-floor kicks, snares, and frenzied sixteenth-note hi-hats before a sparse breakdown and final charge.
code:
setcpm(160/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1).shape(0.3),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(150, 700)).resonance(14).decay(0.18).sustain(0).gain(0.8)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.15).shape(0.35),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).pan(sine.range(0.2, 0.8)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(200, 2200)).resonance(16).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.85)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.2).shape(0.4),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.75).room(0.25),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55).pan(sine.fast(2).range(0.2, 0.8)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.25),
    s("~ ~ ~ oh").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(250, 2600)).resonance(18).decay(0.11).sustain(0).gain(0.9).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<c2 eb2 g2 bb1>").s("sawtooth").lpf(900).gain(0.45).room(0.4).off(0.0625, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [20, stack(
    note("<c2 eb2 g1 ab1>").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(10).range(180, 800)).resonance(12).gain(0.6).room(0.5).delay(".4:.1875:.5"),
    s("~ ~ rim ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).room(0.6),
    s("[~ hh]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.35).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1),
    note("<c3 eb3 g2 c3>").s("triangle").lpf(1200).gain(0.4).room(0.6).attack(0.05).release(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.15).shape(0.4),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).pan(sine.range(0.2, 0.8)).cut(1).ply("<1 1 2 4>"),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).room(0.3),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(200, 3000)).resonance(18).decay(0.11).sustain(0).gain(0.9)
  )],
  [40, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.2).shape(0.45),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.78).room(0.25),
    s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).pan(sine.fast(4).range(0.15, 0.85)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3),
    s("~ ~ oh ~ ~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(6).range(300, 3200)).resonance(20).decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.95).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 2 4>")),
    note("<c3 eb3 g3 bb2>*2").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(12).range(600, 2400)).resonance(8).gain(0.4).delay(".5:.125:.6").sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(2))
  )],
  [20, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.05).shape(0.3),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.45).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("square").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(700, 150)).resonance(12).decay(0.16).sustain(0).gain(0.75).room(0.3)
  )]
)
